notes: Validation split only; test never read.
Routing: HIGH = fraud_score > 30 first (any status, fixed); non-HIGH Pending/Reversed -> rule (auto); non-HIGH Approved/Declined -> REVIEW if raw score >= cut else LOW (auto).
automation_rate = (n_rule + n_low) / n_charges; missed_fraud = fraud in LOW / all validation fraud (n=610), Wilson 95% CI.
Cuts: 199 log-spaced over the non-HIGH score range plus the exact default t_low (default: true).
cost_per_case is absent until Analytics adds it with analytics/simulator_cost.py (the script refuses a pre-existing key).

Contract aliases (analytics/simulator_cost.py, static/js/metrics.js): t_low = cut, is_default = default, missed_fraud_n/rate/ci_lo/ci_hi = missed_fraud.k/rate/ci_low/ci_high, wrongful_autoclose_per_10k = missed_fraud.k / n_charges * 10000, n_fraud = n_fraud_total, model_version = version.

llm_cost_source.source: mean of 22 audit rows in app.audit_llm_call (QA/test traffic) at OpenAI Standard $0.15/1M in + $0.60/1M out, fetched 2026-10-03; 80 direct API calls gave $0.0000600/call; calls per case from app/cases/engine.py, confirmed by the audit rows

cost_model.llm_cost_label: measured from 22 QA audit rows (live calls)
cost_model.human_cost_source: team-locked human cost per dispute resolution; analytics/out/cost_proj_per_resolution.csv (Queja, mean handle time 434.6 s, resolution rate 0.4364, $6/$12/$20 per hour)
cost_model.formula: expected = sum(llm_band*share_band) + human*(review+high); human_only = human per charge; net_savings_per_case = human_only - expected
cost_model.fields: per point cost_per_case / human_only / net_savings_per_case, each {low, mid, high} human-cost scenario, USD per charge
assumptions: A1: HIGH cases cost one LLM turn (llm_high) plus one human resolution.
A2: the Pending/Reversed rule path is template-only (llm_rule, default 0) and never needs a human.
A3: human-only baseline = one human resolution per charge.

default_point_summary.quote_mid: At the default cut (18.01% automation), expected $2.72 per charge vs $3.32 human-only: $0.60 saved per charge (mid scenario, validation set).
